NATIVE TRANSPARENT EXTERIOR PASS AND EVIDENCE LIMITS:
Return a native RGBA with actual transparency outside the complete silhouette, never a white, gray or colored working-matte halo. Do not paint a checkerboard or green screen. Do not invent readable writing, extra note rows, symbols, people or comparison panels. Keep full returned detail and the source composition; no watermark.
